exclusion_detail: The pigments are made only by enzymatic whole-cell biotransformation (E. coli expressing 4,5-DODA, alpha-methyl-DOPA plus indoline in a bioreactor, 72 h), then purified by prep HPLC; there is no chemical synthesis step a retrosynthesis planner could reproduce, and no product name or drawn-structure text is given for the lead.

lead.label: indoline-6-methyl-betacyanin
lead.why: Abstract: 'indoline-6-methyl-betacyanin identified as the most antioxidant'.

notes: Section 2.4 of the article: all ten methylated betalains come from the same enzymatic one-pot biotransformation of commercial alpha-methyl-DOPA with amines/amino acids/indoline. If a looser rule accepted enzymatic steps, the route would be one pot from alpha-methyl-DOPA + indoline, but the lead's structure is not printed in the text layer, so not transcribed.
